items.title: Ukraine says Starshield restrictions remain in effect
items.summary: Ukraine's acting chargé d'affaires in the United States, Denys Senyk, said restrictions on the Starshield system remain in place. He said the parties involved had been unable to establish who made the decision to impose them.

items.title: Austrian politician proposes postwar refugee transfers to Ukraine
items.summary: Austrian politician Herbert Kickl suggested that Ukraine should accept Syrian and Afghan refugees who cannot be returned to their countries of origin after the war, citing European financial assistance to Kyiv. The remarks represent his proposal rather than an adopted Austrian government policy.

items.title: Finland reportedly approves multinational armoured vehicle procurement
items.summary: Finland reportedly approved the purchase of 160 armoured vehicles on November 26 under a joint European procurement programme involving four other countries. The Finnish portion was reported to be worth approximately $3.07 billion, with an option for additional vehicles and partial financing through the EU's SAFE programme.
